english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “shot” means an opportunity or chance to try.
This is the all-purpose choice for an opportunity or an attainable possibility.
This is the all-purpose noun for a chance to advance, make progress, or profit.
This is the all-purpose choice for a favorable or timely opportunity.

english.note: This is the everyday choice for the chance that an event will happen, especially in estimates such as 有幾大機會.
Use this for an everyday chance or likelihood, rather than a technical probability.
Use this when the possibility is a realistic chance that an event will happen, as in 有機會落雨.
